decisions.reason: As a close-to-core product still prominently marketed after its 2023 launch, it likely meets or is near aspiration levels and fits the firm's integrated equipment portfolio, so management would usually retain it.

Because this product is distant from the firm's established dental and hearing-focused business, any performance shortfall against aspirations would more likely trigger problemistic search and reallocation of resources back to core areas.

Although still new and only lightly evidenced on the website, it is close to the firm's digital production offer, and with industry growth and some organisational slack management would typically give it more time to prove itself.
